## Projects

- [Elevare — AI Email Manager](https://elevare-karanmali2001s-projects.vercel.app/): Full-stack AI-powered email manager with custom queue management system achieving 40% faster email processing. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, Groq AI, RazorPay
- [Matchup — Tournament Management](https://github.com/KaranMali2001/matchup): High-concurrency tournament platform supporting 1000+ concurrent users using Go routines. Stack: Go, PostgreSQL, REST API
- [Enhanced Dimaag — AI Content Sharing](https://enhanced-dimaag.vercel.app/): YouTube video summarization with RAG, vector embeddings, LangChain, and Google Gemini. Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Clerk
- [Bidding Management System](https://bidding-management-system.vercel.app/): RBAC-based bidding platform with Cloudinary integration and esbuild-optimized builds. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, React Query
- [Auto-Blog — AI Content Creation](https://auto-blog-opal.vercel.app/): AI-powered blog generation and publishing platform. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI API, MongoDB
